annotations.title: Invite a person to your organization

description: Invite a colleague to the user's OWN Vendooly organization (the one of this connection — you cannot choose another). Use when the user says "invite this person to my account/team". Only owners/admins can invite. `role` is admin (sees every seller) or member (sees only the sellers listed in `seller_ids`; get them from list_team_members → sellers). With send_email=true (default) Vendooly emails the invitation; with send_email=false NO email is sent and the tool returns an invite link (valid 7 days) for the user to pass on. Ask the user to confirm the email and role before calling.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

email.description: Email of the person to invite.

role.description: admin = full access; member = only the sellers in seller_ids.

seller_ids.description: For role=member: seller ids (from list_team_members → sellers) the member may see.

send_email.description: true (default): email the invitation. false: no email, return the invite link.

name: invite_team_member
